findings.standard: An Instar Agent Is Always a Multi-Machine Entity
findings.reason: The companion protocol collapses creator-only storage and independently signed copies into one Pending state, and makes context usable without requiring shared commitment or requiring a returning member to repair missing context before serving a current view.

findings.standard: Know Your Principal — An Unverified Identity Is a Guess
findings.reason: The draft treats a Chief of Staff handoff ID as authorization for the work without identifying the verified principal behind the handoff or establishing that principal’s authority over its scope.
